Hazimel - Ravnos - 11
dem ANI AUS CHI FOR POT
Independent: Hazimel has 2 votes (titled).
Non-Ravnos vampires must burn 2 blood to attempt a (D) action that
targets Hazimel or a card or counter on him. +1 bleed.

So.. if my predator plays a Pentex Subversion on my Hazimel, does it
cost 2 additional blood to attempt to burn it? My guess is 'yes' but
just checking.

FUN FACT: Hazimel is the first vampire in the game who can play
Nightmare Curse at superior with no discipline improvements! :)
